name: @pipeworx/mcp-eia

tools.name: eia_series
tools.description: Search EIA for any energy data series by route path. Returns historical data points with timestamps and values. Use for specific energy metrics not covered by category tools.(e.g., "petroleum/pri/gnd" for gasoline prices, "natural-gas/pri/sum" for gas prices, "electricity/retail-sales" for electricity, "total-energy/data" for total energy). Returns time series with period, value, and metadata.

route.description: EIA data route path. Common routes: "petroleum/pri/gnd" (gasoline/diesel prices), "petroleum/pri/spt" (crude oil spot prices), "petroleum/stoc/wstk" (petroleum stocks), "petroleum/sum/sndw" (petroleum supply/demand weekly), "natural-gas/pri/sum" (natural gas prices), "natural-gas/stor/sum" (natural gas storage), "electricity/retail-sales" (electricity sales/prices), "total-energy/data" (total energy overview), "coal/shipments" (coal data)

start.description: Start date, e.g., "2023-01" for monthly, "2023" for annual (optional)

tools.name: eia_petroleum
tools.description: Get EIA petroleum time series data for a specific product (gasoline, diesel, crude, stocks, supply, production, imports). Returns prices or volumes by period with regional breakdowns. Requires free EIA API key.supply, production, and imports. Simplified interface to common EIA petroleum series.

product.description: Product type: "gasoline" (retail pump price), "diesel" (retail pump price), "crude" (WTI spot), "stocks", "supply", "production", "imports"

grade.description: Gasoline grade, for product "gasoline" only: "regular" (default — the national headline price), "midgrade", "premium", or "all" (all grades combined).

area.description: Retail prices only: "US" (default, national average), "all" (every region EIA reports), or an EIA area code such as "R10" (East Coast) or "SCA" (California).

frequency.description: Frequency: "weekly", "monthly", "annual" (optional; retail prices default to weekly)

tools.name: us_fuel_price
tools.description: US gas station prices: the weekly national average retail pump price per gallon of regular, midgrade or premium gasoline, or diesel, from the U.S. Energy Information Administration's Weekly Retail Gasoline and Diesel Prices survey. Answers "current average US gas price", "national average price of regular unleaded", "how much is a gallon of gas", "diesel price at the pump". Pass fuel "gasoline" with grade (regular is the default, the national headline figure) or fuel "diesel"; area defaults to the US average. Returns the latest week first with the series name, so the grade and area are stated in every answer.

grade.description: Gasoline grade: "regular" (default — the national headline price), "midgrade", "premium", or "all" (all grades combined). Ignored for diesel.

area.description: "US" (default, national average), "all" (every region EIA reports), or an EIA area code such as "R10" (East Coast) or "SCA" (California).

start.description: Earliest week to include, YYYY-MM-DD (optional; default the most recent 24 weeks).

tools.name: eia_natural_gas
tools.description: Get EIA natural gas time series for a named series (prices, production, consumption, storage, spot_prices). Returns period, value, and area metadata. Requires free EIA API key.Includes Henry Hub spot prices, underground storage, marketed production, and consumption by sector.

tools.name: eia_electricity
tools.description: Get EIA electricity data for a named series (generation, retail_sales, prices, state_generation). Returns time series with period and value across fuel sources and regions. Requires free EIA API key.Covers coal, natural gas, nuclear, hydro, wind, and solar generation.

tools.name: eia_ethanol
tools.description: Get fuel ethanol production volumes, stocks, and imports. Returns time series for ethanol supply chain metrics.Key energy-agriculture intersection: most US ethanol is made from corn. Uses EIA petroleum supply data filtered for ethanol (EPOOXE product code).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-eia forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the eia pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
